types.name: JsonError
types.description:
Last JSON error of the facade.
The predeclared instance `JsonError` tracks the current error. `Snapshot` copies it into `tJsonErrInfo` before the next fallible operation overwrites it.

### Notes
- There is no `SetError` on this class.
- Getters on the predeclared instance read the last-error store.

### Example
```basic
Dim v As Variant
v = Json.Parse(s)
If JsonError.HasError Then Debug.Print JsonError.ToString()
```

members.name: Snapshot

members.description:
Snapshot of the current error.
The next fallible facade call does not change this value.

### Syntax

### Example
```basic
Dim snap As tJsonErrInfo
snap = JsonError.Snapshot()
v = Json.Parse(nextJson)
```
